question: Should OpenClaw runtime Docker/Podman containers expose the agent workspace at `/workspace`, or should `/workspace` remain sandbox-only?
rationale: Both choices are plausible, but the decision changes the supported container workspace contract across runtime containers, sandbox docs, rootless Podman behavior, and setup helpers, so automation should not pick the policy by itself.

options.title: Implement a consistent runtime alias
options.body: Add a `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, Docker setup, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke proof so container users have one ergonomic path.

options.title: Document sandbox-only semantics
options.body: Keep runtime containers on `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` and update docs/templates that imply `/workspace` is generally available outside sandbox containers.

options.title: Defer behind Docker sandbox path work
options.body: Resolve the adjacent Docker-out-of-Docker workspaceAccess path contract first, then apply one workspace path policy to runtime and sandbox containers.

recommendation.title: Implement a consistent runtime alias
recommendation.body: Add a `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, Docker setup, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke proof so container users have one ergonomic path.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current-source signal across Dockerfile, Compose, Docker setup, Podman launcher, and recent Docker docs/setup history.
